died.name: Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Lützen (1632)
died.last_words: I have enough, brother; try to save your own life.

died.name: Jack Sheppard
died.last_words: I have ever cherished an honest pride; never have I stooped to friendship with Jonathan Wild, or with any of his detestable thief-takers; and though an undutiful son, I never damned my mother's eyes.

born.name: John Selman
born.last_words: You god damned son-of-a-bitch, I am going to kill you!
